sentences.text: Task 1. You will listen to a meeting at Aberdeen College where people are discussing the college’s new online systems.
Listen to the meeting and fill in the missing information in the spaces provided in the note sheet.
One has been done for you as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task you will have One minute to tidy up your answers.
OK, good morning, everybody.
Thanks for coming to the meeting today.
I know today’s Saturday and I'm sure you've got other things to do on a Saturday morning, but hopefully the meeting will be a short one.
Do you two.
know each other?
No, I don’t think so.
OK, well, this is Rob Lee.
Rob’s the College Technician, so he can advise us on technical and Rob Hi.
Hi. Yeah, and Rob I think you know Cherry.
Our Student President?
OK. Right so, as I said in my email, I wanted to discuss what needs to be done to improve the College’s online systems.
So maybe we could start with the college website.
Any comments from students about the website?
Well, the first thing I've written here about the website is that it’s like boring.
Students are always saying that Yeah, I agree with Cherry actually.
It’s a bit boring.
I think the thing that I would add would be that it’s not user friendly.
Yeah, I'd agree.
It certainly isn’t user -friendly.
What about the other services, like the Intranet system for teachers.
Intranet? Is that, like, where the teachers can communicate with each other?
Yeah, the teachers can use the intranet to send files as well like documents, pictures, video clips.
Well, Why don’t they just use their email?
Because it isn't secure.
You know it's it’s not safe to send files like that.
And the internet has the advantage that it’s secure because it’s protected by the College’s firewall.
Hmm, OK, let’s move on.
What kinds of things would we like to see available online line from the new system?
Cherry? Well, I think a social network.
You know, something like Facebook.
Maybe a place where we could chat online about school stuff with schoolmates and teachers Wait so you would want teachers to be able to go to this social network as well?
As well as students I mean.
Sure, why not?
OK, well that’s one idea.
What else? How about an online market?
What, like, for people to buy and sell things?
Yeah, a market.
I was thinking you know, we could like sell things like our old textbooks books and students in lower forms could buy them.
Sounds good. I think that would work.
Right, OK. Let’s move on to the action we need to take, First, the website, can you be responsible for that Rob?
For what? The re-design of the website Well, my programming I mean, they're pretty basic.
But I know a web designer so I could contact him.
Maybe. to give us a price Okay, Right, So you contact the web designer then Rob.
How about the other systems we talked about?
Well. why don’t I carry out a survey of the students to see what it is they want from our online systems?
Great idea, Cherry.
It’s really important that we get the students views on this.
I think a survey of the students is an excellent idea.
So yeah, you can do that Cherry.
Fine And I'll do the same with the teachers.
We need to get their input as well.
So a survey is good.
Right. OK, so that’s about all we can do today.
Let's meet again next week at the same time.
I’m sorry, I think I'll need more time than a week.
Can we meet in two week’s time?
OK, two weeks it is then.
